title: 3v3 One-Dribble Maximum Game
description: A half-court 3v3 limiting every player to one dribble maximum per touch, speeding up decision-making and ball movement.

content.objective: Speed up decision-making by limiting every touch to a single dribble at most.
content.setup: Three offensive players face three defenders in a half-court game with the dribble limited.
instructions: Play live 3v3 to a target score.
Each player may take at most one dribble per touch before passing or shooting.
A second dribble on the same touch results in a turnover.
Rotate teams after every four possessions.
coachingPoints: Catch already thinking about the next pass, not just the dribble.
Move without the ball to create easy one-dribble advantages.
Use the one dribble purposefully — toward the rim or to improve a passing angle.
commonMistakes: Taking the one dribble immediately out of habit instead of looking to pass first.
Standing still and forcing a tough shot rather than passing to a better-positioned teammate.
Reverting to one-on-one play instead of using the whole group.
content.safety: Keep contact controlled; call fouls to maintain a fair pace.
